always_layer_rule.desc: submit cos_k5 at layer 18 and contr_k5 at layer 12

exJ_verifier.desc: reference greedy; submit its best prefix if the example objective J >= t, else 'cannot' (t by CV)

selftest_rank_R_A.desc: 15 ranked sets (contr/naive/cos top-1..5), pick best on self-test A, submit if >= t else 'cannot'

selftest_all_R_A.desc: ranked sets + greedy prefixes + activation/logit-lens sets, best on self-test A, threshold t

selftest_rank_R_B.desc: 15 ranked sets (contr/naive/cos top-1..5), pick best on self-test B, submit if >= t else 'cannot'

selftest_all_R_B.desc: ranked sets + greedy prefixes + activation/logit-lens sets, best on self-test B, threshold t

selftest_rank_R_AB.desc: 15 ranked sets (contr/naive/cos top-1..5), pick best on self-test AB, submit if >= t else 'cannot'

selftest_all_R_AB.desc: ranked sets + greedy prefixes + activation/logit-lens sets, best on self-test AB, threshold t

selftest_budget60_Bsmall.desc: 3 ranked sets (contr/cos/naive top-5) each tested on 10 new-entity target + 10 sibling prompts (60 forward passes per slot); submit the best if >= t else 'cannot'

selftest_contr5_AB.desc: submit contr_k5 if its self-test R (A+B) >= t, else 'cannot'

prior_textstats_layer_rule.desc: logistic prior on family, layer, group-name frequency, answer token id (no model run) decides 'cannot'; otherwise submit cos_k5 (L18) / contr_k5 (L12)

prior_family_layer_only.desc: same with family and layer only

prior_plus_selftest_rank.desc: logistic on text statistics + best self-test R of the 15 ranked sets; submit that set or 'cannot'

prior_plus_selftest_all_plus_exJ.desc: logistic on text statistics + self-test R (all candidate sets) + example objective J

memo_label_layer_rule.desc: remember which cells are null (seen before, labels only); else cos_k5 (L18) / contr_k5 (L12)

memo_label_best_cheap_recipe.desc: remember null cells AND which cheap ranking worked for this cell (reward only, ID-free)
